settings.kernel: sum of normalized RBF deep kernels
settings.validation: 1:1 stratified split inside the support budget; no extra labeled data
settings.one_shot_objective: GP marginal likelihood; ridge lambda fixed to 0.01
settings.final_fit: all support samples, after hyperparameter selection
settings.prior: gamma * softmax(tau * CLIP text-image cosine similarity)
settings.probability_mapping: GP/ridge: clamp scores at 1e-8 and normalize; zero-shot: softmax(tau=100)
settings.probability_limit: mapped GP categorical NLL/ECE are conventions, not the Gaussian predictive likelihood
settings.uncertainty: latent GP variance, independent of class; not an OOD benchmark
settings.aggregate: mean and sample standard deviation across seeds
deviations: ridge label-regression probe rather than paper's ensemble baselines
